## Shared and model-specific confusions

A confusion cell (true → predicted) counts for a model when it holds at least 2% of that class's test windows (summed over the seeds). Shared: every model; model-specific: one or two models; partly shared: the rest.

**Shared (2)**
- Sitting → Standing: mlp 10.5%, cnn1d 14.9%, bilstm 17.4%, gru 19.2%, transformer 26.6%
